meta.title: {appName} — jobs backed by verified skills
meta.description: A job board where every application is backed by a two-stage interview: a practical task and a spoken conversation with an AI interviewer.

theme.toggle: Switch between light and dark theme

hero.title: Get hired on proven skill, not on a résumé
hero.lead: Every application here is backed by a two-stage interview: a practical task, then a spoken conversation with an AI interviewer. Employers see real results instead of polished résumés, and you learn exactly what to improve.
hero.scopeNote: IT roles for now: development, QA, data analytics, DevOps.

sample.caption: What an employer sees
sample.replay: How the code was written is recorded
sample.replayHint: The employer can replay every edit.
sample.decision: AI prepares scores and explanations; HR makes the decision.

steps.title: How the interview works
steps.lead: Four steps in one window. The rules are stated up front and you accept them before anything starts.

rules.title: Rules
rules.body: Before you begin, you read and accept the rules: pasting code from outside is blocked, and long inactivity ends the interview.

stage1.title: Stage 1: practical task
stage1.body: You write code in the platform's editor and run the visible tests. Hidden tests and a code review decide the result.

stage2.title: Stage 2: oral interview
stage2.body: An AI interviewer asks questions by voice, mostly about the code you just wrote. Explaining your own code is easy.

results.title: Results
results.body: You get a percentage score and explanations for both stages. The employer sees a ranked shortlist with the evidence.

home.principle: AI scores and explains why. A person makes the final hiring decision.

candidates.title: For candidates
candidates.body: Skills you verify once stay on your profile and count towards future applications. Even a rejection comes with a reason: you see what was missing.

employers.title: For employers
employers.body: Post a vacancy, write the questions and tasks yourself or draft them with AI. Instead of hundreds of résumés, get a ranked list of verified candidates with a replay of how the code was written.

footer.tagline: A job board where skills are verified.

intro.title: Stage 2: spoken interview with AI
intro.lead: An AI interviewer asks questions, mostly about the code you wrote in Stage 1. Explaining your own code is easy.
intro.point1: Each question is shown on screen and read aloud. Listen, then answer.
intro.point2: Every answer has a time limit; the timer is on screen.
intro.point3: If you need a moment, "Let me think" extends the time once per question.
intro.point4: A long silence brings a warning; if it goes on, the interview ends.
intro.recordedTitle: Your voice is recorded and stored
intro.recordedBody: The voice in your answers is recorded and stored so the employer can review it. By continuing you agree to this.
intro.textOffer: The microphone is not working. You can continue by typing your answers.
intro.startText: Continue in text, without a microphone
intro.testFirst: Test your microphone first to start.
intro.textNote: If you continue in text, the employer will see that you did. Pasting from outside is disabled in text mode.
intro.coveredLead: Your verified skills cover every question, so there is nothing to answer. No microphone is needed.
